name: Quickpay

evidence.gateway: F02: online payment gateway connecting checkout to acquirers; the merchant is the seller
evidence.links: F16: one-off payment links created in Manager, or generated through the API

line: European gateway for card, bank, wallet, and payment-link checkout.

free.text: Free to create and test; live plans have monthly and transaction fees

cells.countries: Listed European countries, including UK and Germany
cells.payout: Next day via Nets/banks; Clearhaus says 1–3 days

fee.math: Quickpay has no payment processor that offers agreements to merchants outside Europe. The US is outside Europe.
The UK is eligible, but no UK card rate in pounds (GBP) is published. Public European card pricing is in euros (EUR).
The payment processor's rate starts at 1.35% (with a EUR 0.10 minimum) plus EUR 0.03. Quickpay adds EUR 0.10 per transaction. The processor's rate may be higher.
Quickpay has no payment processor that offers agreements to merchants outside Europe. India is outside Europe.
